mapper.insert: insert into draw_record (draw_id, user_id, address_book_id, shoe_size, sku_id, status, order_no, create_time) values (#{drawId}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{shoeSize}, #{skuId}, #{status}, #{orderNo}, #{createTime})

insert ignore into draw_record (id, draw_id, user_id, address_book_id, shoe_size, sku_id, status, order_no, create_time) values (#{id}, #{drawId}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{shoeSize}, #{skuId}, #{status}, #{orderNo}, #{createTime})

insert ignore into draw_record (id, draw_id, user_id, address_book_id, shoe_size, sku_id, status, order_no, create_time) values
(#{r.id}, #{r.drawId}, #{r.userId}, #{r.addressBookId}, #{r.shoeSize}, #{r.skuId}, #{r.status}, #{r.orderNo}, #{r.createTime})

select * from draw_record where draw_id = #{drawId} order by id desc
select * from draw_record where draw_id = #{drawId} and status = 0 order by id desc
select user_id from draw_record where draw_id = #{drawId}
select * from draw_record where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
mapper.update:
update draw_record
status = #{status},
order_no = #{orderNo},
where id = #{id}
and (order_no is null or order_no = '')
mapper.select: select dr.id as recordId, dr.user_id as userId, u.name as userName, u.phone as userPhone, dr.shoe_size as shoeSize, dr.order_no as orderNo, dr.create_time as joinTime, d.title as prizeName, d.draw_time as winTime, dr.status as status from draw_record dr join user u on u.id = dr.user_id join draw d on d.id = dr.draw_id where dr.draw_id = #{drawId} and dr.status = 1 order by dr.id desc

select dr.user_id as userId, u.name as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar, dr.shoe_size as shoeSize, dr.create_time as joinTime from draw_record dr join user u on u.id = dr.user_id where dr.draw_id = #{drawId} and dr.status = 1 order by dr.id desc

select dr.id as id, dr.draw_id as drawId, d.title as drawTitle, d.target_type as targetType, dr.shoe_size as shoeSize, dr.status as status, dr.order_no as orderNo, dr.create_time as createTime from draw_record dr join draw d on d.id = dr.draw_id where dr.user_id = #{userId} order by dr.create_time desc
select id, draw_id, user_id, status, order_no from draw_record where order_no = #{orderNo} limit 1
